source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical Hub conversion adopts shared color roles. Newer accepted names use surface and critical rather than the older neutral and danger families. Hub-specific properties map roles to normal, hover, active and focus states; shared role tokens select light and dark values. Manual CSS proposal for this family: use role and state names such as --hub-account-primary-button-background-hover and --color-primary-hover when those tokens fit the control. This does not ban every raw color or require a mechanical rename of all old tokens. Static token inspection does not prove measured contrast.
title: Name Account Hub colors by semantic role and control state
